definition: a marked area where a game is played
description: A point of view shot from one end of an orange clay tennis court, high in the mountains. The white lines of the court run away from the camera to the net across the middle, and beyond it a grey rock face with snow on top rises into a deep blue sky under a bright sun. On the far side of the net a player in red hits the ball back; the yellow ball bounces on the clay and crosses the net again and again. The player at the camera end reaches into the frame to play a shot, and the rally goes on across the empty court with the mountain behind it.

de.answer: Der Spieler sprintet über den Tennisplatz.
de.question: Was macht der Spieler?

es.answer: El jugador está esprintando por la pista.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el jugador?

fr.answer: Le joueur sprinte à travers le court.
